items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Sometimes referred to as an alley bow by rogues or ruffians, this small crossbow fires small bolts that are sometimes used to deliver poison to the target. It's small enough to be shot one-handed, but it still requires two hands to load.

items.name: Club
items.description: This is a piece of stout wood shaped or repurposed to bludgeon an enemy. Clubs can be intricately carved pieces of martial art or as simple as a tree branch or piece of wood.

items.name: Cytillesh Toolkit
items.description:
These healer's toolkits are collections of crystalline scalpels and gritty salves made of cytillesh. They all glow the same sickly blue. While the toolkit is outside its opaque container, it sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius. Any non-dero using or wearing the toolkit is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Sickened]{Sickened 1} until 1 hour after they've stopped, which cannot be reduced during that time.

This kit of bandages, herbs, and suturing tools is necessary for Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Administer First Aid], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Treat Disease], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Treat Poison], or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Treat Wounds]. If you wear your healer's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

defensiveAbilities.name: Vulnerable to Sunlight
defensiveAbilities.description: A dero stalker takes 4 Untyped Damage damage for every hour they're exposed to sunlight.

offensiveAbilities.name: Dero Medicine
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The dero is wearing a cytillesh toolkit and has a hand free

Effect The dero excises damaged flesh and crudely stitches wounds shut, healing themself or an ally in reach for 2d8 Healing Damage{2d8 Hit Points}. For 1 hour, the target has slashing weakness 2 and is immune to Dero Medicine.

Effect: Dero Medicine

offensiveAbilities.name: Exploit Lethargy
offensiveAbilities.description: A creature afflicted with Lethargy Poison is Off-Guard to the dero stalker, and the stalker can choose to add the nonlethal trait to their attacks against the creature without taking the normal penalty.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: A dero stalker deals 1d6 extra precision damage to creatures who are Off-Guard.

cantrips.name: Daze
cantrips.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt. The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also Stunned 1.

Heightened (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.

cantrips.name: Light
cantrips.description:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

cantrips.name: Read Aura
cantrips.description:
You focus on the target object, opening your mind to perceive magical auras. When the casting is complete, you know whether that item is magical. You or anyone you advise about the aura gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Identify Magic on the item. If the object is illusory, you detect this only if the effect's rank is lower than the rank of your read aura spell.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to 10 objects.

Heightened (6th) You can target any number of objects.
